description: List all jobs across one or more Ashby job boards, or fetch a single job by ID.

department.description: Keep only jobs whose department contains this text (case-insensitive), e.g. `Engineering`, `Sales`, `Design`. Applies in mode=byOrg.
department.title: Filter by department

isRemoteOnly.description: Keep only jobs flagged as remote. Applies in mode=byOrg.
isRemoteOnly.title: Remote jobs only

jobId.description: The Ashby job posting UUID, e.g. `09a9381c-677b-40a5-9ff1-027bd4302c13`. Found in a job URL: `https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/{org}/{jobId}`.
jobId.title: Job ID (mode=jobDetail)

location.description: Keep only jobs whose primary or secondary location contains this text (case-insensitive), e.g. `New York`, `Remote`, `London`. Applies in mode=byOrg.
location.title: Filter by location

maxItems.description: Hard cap on the number of job records emitted.
maxItems.title: Max items

enumTitles: Fetch a single job by ID
mode.title: Mode

orgSlug.description: Single Ashby company slug that owns the job (e.g. `Ramp`).
orgSlug.title: Organization slug (mode=jobDetail)

orgSlugs.description: One or more Ashby company slugs, e.g. `Ramp`, `Notion`, `Linear`. You can also paste a full board URL like `https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Ramp` and the slug is extracted automatically.
orgSlugs.title: Organization slugs (mode=byOrg)
